desc:
👊 **"FIAS Reborn"** is an all-out free-for-all brawler set in a chaotic high school! Team up, chill with classmates, or throw hands and prove who runs the halls!

💬 **Community-driven:** We listen to player feedback and use it to improve updates, balance changes, new moves, and future content.

💥 Like and favorite for updates, new moves, and exclusive items!
Supports: PC, Console, Mobile

🎮 **Controls:**
**PC:**
Left Click → Attack
Hold Space + WASD → Dodge/Weave
LeftShift → Sprint

**Console:**
R2 → Attack
Hold L2 + Analog Stick → Weave/Dodge

**Mobile:**
Punch icon → Attack
Hold Dodge button + Move → Weave

🔥 Check out more controls and combos in-game!

**Version v1.1.2 BETA — 5/17/2026**
(All credit to Ethourah and Fight in a School Developers Team!)

Tags: School Fight, Arena, PVP, 1v1, Free-for-All, RP, Battle Royale, High School Chaos, Combat
